thread:
natalie_ux: Heads up — our browser sample app is intermittently failing to assemble SSE stream chunks when users close the tab quickly. Repro steps below.
kevin_sdk: ugh, seen that before on a bad network. Is it the final token dupe/merge case or truncated JSON? any logs?
sam_infra: I captured a session dump, looks like we get two partial frames then a sudden connection close. client emits 'abort' and the last fragment is re-sent by server on reconnect which leads to duplicate final token.
olivia_repro: repro steps: open sample app, start generation (gpt-like model), click stop/close after ~400ms. Repeat 5-10x. ~30% of runs produce a parse error in the browser.
kevin_sdk: can you paste the raw chunks you saw? helps to see chunk boundaries and separators.
olivia_repro: sure — raw payload order:
```
data: {"delta":"Hello "}\n\n
data: {"delta":"world"}\n\n
data: {"delta":"!","end":true}\n\n
```
then on reconnect we get:
```
data: {"delta":"!","end":true}\n\n
```
so final token appears twice; our client code concatenates without de-dup and ends up with `!!!` or double finalization which breaks JSON streaming consumer.
kevin_sdk: hmm — SDK behavior: we buffer fragments and re-emit on resume. There's an edge where resume replays the last completed event if last-event-id didn't update due to abort. We probably should compare event payload IDs or dedupe identical terminal events.
natalie_ux: small point — users expect stop to be immediate; but restarting/resume semantics are subtle. any quick mitigation we can land in sample app before SDK fix?
sam_infra: for sample app patch: treat consecutive identical `end` events as idempotent, ignore duplicates within 1s window. that'll stop the parse error and is simple.
kevin_sdk: we should also add a note in SDK: when client aborts, the server may resend final chunk; SDK should attempt to detect and drop duplicate final tokens by content-equality and last-event-id when available. I'll open a follow-up PR.
olivia_repro: prepared a tiny repro gist with network logs, will drop in the thread in a sec.
dev-bot: deploybot: created issue #4521 for `sse: duplicate terminal event on quick client abort` by kevin_sdk.
kevin_sdk: thanks — I'll push a sample-app fix now and then a proper SDK dedupe in next sprint. Can someone review my small patch? it's just a 20-line change in stream parsing.
natalie_ux: will review in ~30m. also let's add a short note to onboarding docs: "if you close tab mid-stream, client may see duplicate terminal chunk — SDK now handles dedupe" so early users aren't confused.
sam_infra: filed a tiny changelog entry and added the mitigation to the sample app. marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
